comparison.objective: Install a rack rail versus align two pulley faces using a straightedge.
comparison.physical_skill: Spring-prong insertion across separated posts, telescoping and fastening versus sliding/turning a motor while gauging coplanarity.
comparison.success_condition: Same rack unit, full spring extension and correct screws versus released motor with combined angular/parallel misalignment at most 0.5 degree.
comparison.reason: Both involve alignment over distance, but pulley metrology does not test insertion, retention or fastening. Candidate numeric alignment tolerance and force limits are incomplete.
